# Step 3.6 Plot Figure 6B

Load library and data
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
df <- read_tsv("/Users/cmdb/trip-genomic-context/enhancer-IR/results/figure6B_summary.tsv") 
```

Put Start on the left and End on the right
```{r}
df <- df %>% 
  mutate(x = if_else(side == "Start",
                     -distance_kb - 30, distance_kb + 30))
```

Plot relative enhancer frequency around genes
```{r}
p <- df %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = x, y = relative_frequency, group = side)) +
  # highlight the gene body
  annotate("rect",
           xmin = -30, xmax = 30,
           ymin = 0, ymax = Inf,
           fill = "grey90") +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(color = "steelblue", size = 1) +
  # expected background frequency (relative frequency =1)
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate("text", 
           x = 0, y = 0.15,
           label = "Gene", size = 4)+
  # labe distances relative to gene Start and End
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(-230, -130, -30, 30, 130, 230),
                     label = c("-200", "-100", "Start", "End", "100", "200")) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-240, 240)) +
  labs(title = "Figure 6B reanalysis",
       x = "Distance from gene (kb)",
       y = "Relative enhancer frequency") +
  theme_classic()

p
```
Save the result
```{r}
# Save the plot
ggsave("/Users/cmdb/trip-genomic-context/enhancer-IR/results/figure6B.png",
       plot = p,
       width = 8,
       height = 5)
```
